title: Upcoming conference appearances!
body_html:
I’ve got a lot of good conferences coming up, and I’m curious to hear from others what the hot industry events are across healthcare, regulation, and health tech in the coming year from your perspective? Are there any gems that are off the beaten path of HLTH?

I will be presenting at the following:

I’m thrilled to be invited speaker at:

  1. The 3rd Annual KOL Relationship Management Summit, March 1-2 (virtual)

  2. American Telehealth Association, in San Antonio, Texas, March 4-6

  3. The American Psychiatric Association Annual meeting, San Francisco May 20-24

    Two presentations, speaking with: Carlene Macmillan, Mimi Winsberg, and Pam Hoffman on the management of suicidal crisis in telehealth settings

    And speaking with Carlene MacMillan, Nolan Williams and Eugene Lipov and novel interventions in psychiatry… And how to get them paid for!

  4. The International Conference for Emergency Medicine (ICEM) 2023, Amsterdam, June 13-16

I will also be bumming around at SXSW, because Carlene is doing a panel with Mimi and Solume, and I’m just there as your second rate David Foster Wallace stand and reporting on a lobster festival for ideas.

And submitting to AACAP for later this year now!
